Maya Patel: Quick coordination thread  planning Redwood + CloudScale + AtlasEdge webinar + regional office-hours followups. Open: swag pickup lockers at in-person hubs, demo failover plan, embargo wording, speaker slide deadline, and social copy owners. Can we lock these by EOD?
Samir Gupta: Locking speakers now. Also proposing 30-min regional office-hours (NA/EU/APAC) the week after the webinar to handle deeper tech Qs. Who owns those?
Ashley Rivera: Swag idea: instead of shipping to APAC we can set up lockers at partner co-working hubs (Singapore, Tokyo). Partners handle last-mile pickup. PatchShip can deliver to locker partner with PO. Pros: avoids customs; Cons: coord overhead. Thoughts?
Priya Rao: CloudScale can coordinate Tokyo hub. AtlasEdge can help Singapore contact. Good call on lockers. Please add pickup QR card in the kit so attendees scan and claim.
Marco Duarte: AtlasEdge: we'll accept loaner returns at Singapore hub. Locker addresses required. Also prefer stickers/notebook vs dev tokens to avoid liability.
Leo Chen: Demo failover: plan A remote on Redwood Dedicated, plan B local AtlasEdge loaner (if available), plan C pre-recorded cold-start clip. Simple healthcheck rule: if p50 latency > 250ms for 10s, auto-switch to clip. I'll add a 1-file shell failover script and a banner slide.
Jen Kim: For embargo: recommend "no public posting until 48 hours after webinar" and include that in speaker briefing. Marketing will own social assets; need final copy by Tue noon. I'll upload co-branded templates.
Maya Patel: Slide deadline = 48h prior. Office-hours owners: Samir will own NA, Priya will own APAC liaison, Ashley will set up hubs with partner contacts.
Ashley Rivera: I will draft locker roster and share addresses. PatchShip quote for locker delivery: add 3bd processing + regional pickup hold. Will need headcount by Monday to finalize counts.
Samir Gupta: Action items: I'll DM speakers for bios and run rehearsal invites. Maya pls confirm speaker order.
partners-bot: Reminder: attach locker addresses and set co-hosts CloudScale, AtlasEdge on the event invite.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Redwood x CloudScale x AtlasEdge: Inference & Ops Webinar" Wed 10:00am PT  invites sent to Maya, Samir, Ashley, Leo, Priya, Marco, Jen.
Maya Patel: Thanks all  please flag any legal/lobbying items under RED in the ops doc. Reconvene Tue 9am PT for full run-through. :thumbsup:
